Double-click (or long-press) the token in each line: does the whole token select?

Below the lines, this browser's own answer, by Selection.modify, which follows the same word boundaries. A sigil's first character is an invisible left-to-right mark, which keeps its handle's digits beside the rest when Arabic text comes before it: in each line the digits stay at the start of the sigil.
